supporting_observations.claim: During the alert window, WS-NKIM-01 made connections to the organization's web proxy on TCP port 8080. Examples occur at 13:35:46, 13:40:24, 13:45:14, 13:50:43, 13:55:47, 14:00:31, 14:05:41, and 14:09:57 UTC, broadly consistent with the reported periodic activity.

The available connection records identify the proxy as the destination, but do not identify the requested external hostname or the process responsible; they therefore do not establish whether the connections were the approved CaseBinder update checks or malicious activity.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy logs for PROXY-MAP-01 were not collected from 13:25 to 14:15 UTC, overlapping the alert window; proxy destinations and request details are unavailable.
Sysmon and Windows Security logs for WS-NKIM-01 were not collected from 13:25 to 14:15 UTC, so process attribution and relevant host activity during most of the alert window cannot be assessed.
Zeek connection records are available, but the cited records show connections to the proxy and do not establish the external HTTPS destination or application.
claims_not_established: Whether the periodic connections reached update.casebinder.com or another destination.
Whether the connections were generated by the approved CaseBinder updater or another process.
Whether the reported HTTPS activity was malicious or benign.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain proxy access logs for WS-NKIM-01 during 13:20–14:20 UTC, including requested hostnames, URLs where available, status, and byte counts.
Obtain endpoint process/network telemetry for WS-NKIM-01 covering the alert window to attribute the connections to a process and user.
If available, review TLS SNI, certificate, or equivalent network metadata for the alerted sessions to identify their destinations.
unrelated_findings: At 13:42 UTC, DC-MAP-01 recorded a Kerberos ticket request for ali.hassan from 10.53.10.22, followed by a successful network logon for ali.hassan on WS-AHASSAN-01 from that same address. The evidence associates 10.53.10.22 with WS-NKIM-01, while inventory says remote administration is only performed from WS-AHASSAN-01. Investigate separately; this does not establish the nature of the alerted proxy activity. (T155-00102, T155-00104, T155-00105)
